camel_example: aliyun ossutil api create-access-point --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccessPoint

fields.help_en:
The name of the access point. The naming conventions are as follows:

The access point name must be unique within a single region under the current Alibaba Cloud account.

The name cannot end with -ossalias.

The name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and cannot start or end with a hyphen (-).

The name must be 3 to 19 characters in length
fields.help_zh:
接入点名称。接入点命名规范如下：

接入点名称在当前阿里云账号单个地域内唯一。

不允许以-ossalias结尾。

只能包括小写字母、数字和短划线（-），不能以短划线（-）开头或结尾。

命名长度为3~19个字符
fields.name: access_point_name

fields.help_en:
The network source of the endpoint. Valid values:
vpc: The endpoint can be accessed only through the specified VPC ID.
internet: The endpoint can be accessed over both the Internet and internal network endpoints
fields.help_zh: 接入点网络来源。返回值如下：  vpc：限制仅支持通过指定的VPC ID访问接入点。  internet：同时持通过外网和内网Endpoint互联网访问接入点
fields.name: network_origin

fields.help_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is required only when NetworkOrigin is set to vpc
fields.help_zh: 仅当NetworkOrigin取值为vpc时，需要指定VPC ID
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The container that stores VPC network source information
fields.help_zh: 保存VPC网络来源信息的容器
fields.name: vpc_configuration

parameters.help_zh: 保存接入点配置的容器
